name: Thaumaturgy (Hearth Path) — 2 Intermediate — Rhyme of Discord

system.description: This power confuses intruders within the thaumaturge's haven, causing them to wander in circles no matter how small the space. Intruders must win a Mental Challenge against the caster or become trapped until the spell is broken or expires, and afterward cannot recall details of the haven until they visit it again while unenspelled. Affected intruders may still fight normally if directly engaged. This power lasts 24 hours.
